hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout circle sizing, data-driven domains via d3.extent and root.height, key functions on both node and link joins; classical integrity rules (zero baseline, dual-axis) are inapplicable to this relational topology visualization.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Single-view design and hover/fade interaction manage complexity well, but 300 edge bundles converging at the center create a dense, untraceable tangle at rest that requires interaction to parse.
